effects.t: A deal looks less certain after two claimed attacks on US sites in three days.

effects.label: Gulf states
effects.t: Bahrain accuses Iran of a pattern of hostile acts. Countries that host US forces face a higher risk of being hit.

effects.label: Oil
effects.t: Prices fell early on Monday because traders expect plenty of supply. A wider conflict could reverse that quickly.

event.t: On Sunday 15 November, Bahrain said its air defences intercepted and destroyed several Iranian air attacks before they reached their targets. Sirens and explosions were reported across the country.

Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said they attacked a US military base in Bahrain in response to what they called hostile US actions. Iranian state media said six drones were aimed at a US air-defence radar at a helicopter base.

It is the second such claim in three days. On 13 November the Guards said they had hit a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. The US military denied this and said it shot down two drones with no damage.
It is the first time since September that Bahrain’s air defences have had to stop attacks like this.

There is still no deal to end the war. Reuters reported on Saturday that President Trump has said he might hold off from attacking Iran if there are no new provocations, while keeping the US naval blockade.

headline: Iran says it attacked a US base in Bahrain; Bahrain says it stopped the attacks

summary: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say they sent six drones at a US radar site in Bahrain on Sunday. Bahrain says its air defences destroyed the incoming attacks before they reached their targets.

updates.t: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say they attacked a US base in Bahrain with six drones. Bahrain says its air defences destroyed the incoming attacks.
updates.why: It is the second claimed attack on a US site in Bahrain in three days.

updates.t: Iran’s foreign minister Abbas Araghchi says Iran is still committed to diplomacy. Iran’s naval forces say three oil tankers hit mines near the Strait of Hormuz. Maritime security reports also say a tanker was hit by an unknown projectile off Oman.
updates.why: New incidents at sea keep the risk to Gulf oil exports high.

updates.t: A third US aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, has arrived in the Middle East, Euronews and The National report. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards now say six vessels have caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz since Sunday. The National says these claims could not be independently verified.
updates.why: More US forces in the region and new claims at sea raise the risk of a wider conflict.

updates.t: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say they sent drones at a US radar at Bahrain’s Sheikh Isa Air Base, and Bahrain reports a new attack. Iran’s army says a tanker caught fire after hitting a sea mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.
updates.why: It is the third claimed attack on US sites in Bahrain in five days.

updates.t: US Vice President JD Vance says the campaign against Iran will not become an endless war.

The foreign ministers of Oman and Iran discussed how to keep shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz safe, Reuters and The National report. Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates condemned Iran’s latest attack on Bahrain, the AP reports.

CNN reported, citing seven US officials, that US intelligence shows Iran developing plans to attack senior officials in Washington with a “dirty bomb” or a chemical weapon. Trump said the US takes it very seriously and warned Iran would pay an unprecedented price. Iran’s foreign ministry called the report fabricated.
updates.why: A threat against Washington itself would take the conflict to a new level.

updates.t: The US struck Iranian targets on Qeshm Island, in the Strait of Hormuz, on Tuesday, a US official said, according to Khaleej Times. NPR describes it as a response to Iran’s drone attack on Bahrain; Euronews links it to ships catching fire in the strait.
updates.why: It is a direct US military response, which raises the risk of a wider exchange.

updates.t: An Iranian official confirmed the US strike on Qeshm Island. Gulf News reports that US jets hit a Revolutionary Guards missile site there.

Iran fired at a US air base in Kuwait and several times at Bahrain early on Wednesday, after the US strike on Qeshm. Gulf countries said they intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen.
updates.why: Iran is widening its attacks to more Gulf states, which raises the risk for the region and for oil supplies.

watch: More attacks on Bahrain or other Gulf states
Ship traffic and attacks near the Strait of Hormuz
why: Bahrain hosts the US Navy’s Fifth Fleet, so an attack there is aimed directly at the US military. More attacks make a deal to end the war harder and raise the risk of new US strikes. That keeps the Strait of Hormuz oil route, and oil prices, under pressure.
